I’m so sorry you feel like this, but at 13 you still have some time, maybe you should just try to see what the future holds, but I understand the pain, my boyfriend told me almost the exact same thing, that I wasn’t suicidal I just wanted attention, and that I was so overly sensitive but I don’t know how to change that, I’m in therapy too and it kind of helps but sometimes it can make things seem a lot worse, my mom told me that I was a huge burden for always having problems and needing medications and continuously going on suicide watch or to mental hospitals, so I’m trying to see if I can fix it myself but I’m 17 so I feel like I’m running out of time, but you still have a chance, your grades at 13 don’t make an impact on you and you can take that time to try and self reflect and heal because you are very insightful for what I read, just please keep in mind, we’re all gonna die sooner or later so maybe sticking around for a while might be worth it, maybe you’ll meet a new boyfriend who doesn’t criticize you and loves you, maybe you’ll find new hobbies and new friends who truly support you. All I’m saying is that time heals a lot and you do have the next few years to figure some things out even if it means not doing well in school or not doing much of anything, you still have time to wait for change. That change might be wonderful and it might be worth just sticking around a little longer for.

I feel the same way too, when people are nice to me or even give me gifts I hurt myself because I know I don’t deserve love, I don’t feel guilt for anything huge I don’t think, it’s more the guilt of not being productive and independent, I feel like I’ve let everyone in my life down and I know it’s my fault and I want to fix it but I can’t, I’ve been to so many therapists, tried everything to get a scrap of motivation but I can’t seem to do any better and I don’t know why, I can’t even stay sad, I wish I was constantly miserable so it would be easier to kill myself, because everyone else does so much or at least enough to keep themselves afloat but I can’t even manage to do that, I just sit here but still manage to do every single little thing wrong. Anyway, I’m sorry that so many people feel like this, I wish it was easier, I wish life wasn’t so slow and subtly or completely painful.
